# Comfy Pruna P-Video 2- Image to Video

Turn a single image into video with Pruna P-Video-2. As Pruna's quality-focused video model, its image-to-video mode excels at identity consistency and subtle, natural motion — 720p/1080p, 1-20s duration, plus Draft mode for fast previews. Ideal for image animation, product motion, and poster cinemagraphs. Runs on Comfy Cloud and needs Comfy Cloud partner credits.

**How it works:** The Comfy nodes form the complete template graph. Run submits the graph to Comfy Cloud and saves its outputs.

**Try this:** Change the prompt or the Load node inputs and run again to compare results.

Source: https://github.com/Comfy-Org/workflow_templates/blob/1ae390968e323dba24a6991d1860ded051f5a79b/templates/api_pruna_p_video_i2v.json (MIT). Model licenses apply separately.
